comparison.objective: Identify and switch off a named breaker while leaving other circuits on, versus commission an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual selection and switch actuation rather than tool insertion, bimanual counterholding, collar tuning, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Named circuit off and all others on; no detailed force thresholds are provided. Candidate requires two qualified physical cycles and no drift or hard-stop strike.
comparison.reason: Circuit selection and switching test a different ability from iterative mechanical damping adjustment.
